observations.content: User provided a 12-turn context-only preparation packet for a later implementation task; no implementation was requested in this chunk.

Historical requirements for a later task: expose each observer and consolidator run's actual pi usage cost to the parent orchestrator, including ephemeral and unsuccessful runs when valid usage exists; persist valid costs as session-ledger entries with role/run identity; include all branch costs including abandoned branches in totals; ignore missing, malformed, non-finite, or negative costs; surface total in status/footer UI; add focused tests for aggregation, invalid entries, handoff, and display.

Project PLAN.md specifies observational-memory priorities as performance > speed >= cost and phased delivery: Phase A short-term tier plus TUI, then Phase B long-term tier; Phase B is stated as implemented.

Locked project decisions: spawn ordinary recorded global worker sessions with bespoke child_process.spawn of pi -e agent extension -p rather than subagents; vendor trimmed OM modules with minimal {timestamp, content} schema; use one worker extension parameterized by OM_WORKER=observer|consolidator plus separate orchestrator; orchestrator assigns unique timestamp IDs; dev models are anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 (observer low, consolidator medium); default-off per-session /om gate persisted in ledger.
Phase A intentionally has no consolidator and an unbounded observation buffer until compaction; Phase B adds buffer bounding and .memory file tier.
Repository plan layout centers orchestrator at src/index.ts, ledger modules in src/ledger, shared worker agent under agent/, and tests under tests/; files use om.* ledger custom types.

Core ledger semantics: observations are {timestamp, content, tokenCount}; recorded and dropped entries carry coversUpToId; branch folding applies tombstones and supports /tree rollback; compaction details use om.folded version 1.

Observer pipeline slices source entries at fixed token boundaries, runs parallel workers capped by observerConcurrency, and commits validated results to the master ledger; worker conversation chunks are recorded as the pi -p user prompt for inspectable global sessions.

Compaction deterministically injects Journey, memory map, then active observations; cutoff snaps to a chunk boundary to avoid duplicate representation with verbatim tail; it waits only when in-flight observers can affect the projection, with a fast path to skip unnecessary waits.

Consolidator runs one at a time in background, promotes oldest observations beyond poolTargetTokens, uses scoped .memory tools and updates topic files plus JOURNEY.md; clean exit tombstones handed observations still active, while concurrent new observations are spared. Orchestrator owns/re-renders INDEX.md.

JOURNEY.md is a special, consolidator-authored, append-mostly descriptive history for orientation, not instructions; it is pushed verbatim into compaction before map and observations, excluded from topic listings, and compressed only at the oldest end when over journeyTargetTokens.

README documents default-off /om, status/compact/consolidate commands, global and project config, passive override PI_OM_PASSIVE, ordinary recorded worker sessions, and .memory/ files shared across sessions but not rolled back by /tree.

Config excerpt defaults differ from earlier plan examples: chunkTokens 10000, poolTargetTokens 10000, consolidateAtPoolTokens 15000, compactAtContextTokens 100000, tailTokens 20000, journeyTargetTokens 1000, observerConcurrency 4; passive and debugLog false, mid-run compaction resume true.

Focused tests shown cover timestamp IDs and collisions, ledger folding/tombstones and branch behavior, coverage clocks and tool-call-safe slicing, compaction cutoff and observer wait, projections, memory paths/front-matter/index rendering, pool promotion, rendering, spawn/result IPC, status footer gauges, timeline, and scoped consolidator tools.
